contentItems.title: Cyber-Funk
contentItems.notes: Matt Davis and His Atomic Roller Skates. HyperFollow links to Spotify, Apple Music, iTunes and Amazon; the page previews Stellar Improvisation. Start the loft listening corner here.

contentItems.title: Neon Arcade 1984
contentItems.notes: Matt Davis and His Atomic Roller Skates. The HyperFollow page previews Neon Orbit and lists streaming destinations. A retro cassette in the listening loft matches the arcade-era title.

contentItems.title: Live @ the Tree Bar
contentItems.notes: The supplied fm1m link resolves to Live @ the Tree Bar by Matt Davis and His Atomic Roller Skates, with Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube Music among its listening links.

contentItems.title: Davis Video & Graphic Productions
contentItems.notes: Matt’s main creative-production website: video, graphics, web, print and photography, with service pages, portfolio work and articles. The frame anchors the east-side business display.

contentItems.title: Matt Davis (DVGPro) — YouTube
contentItems.notes: Matt’s supplied YouTube channel. The page title confirms Matt Davis (DVGPro), but channel content was not readable during research; no video or subscriber claims are inferred.

contentItems.title: Davis Clock Services
contentItems.notes: Matt identifies this as his father’s clock business. The site describes family-owned grandfather and antique clock repair, restoration and setup, founded in 1974. The mantel clock marks the family-business corner.

contentItems.title: Apollo’s Learning Corner
contentItems.notes: Children’s learning hub with activities, videos, educational tunes and games. The site includes art, rhythm, fitness, math and nature activities; use the nearby arcade and book for deeper exploration.

contentItems.title: Apollo’s Learning Arcade
contentItems.notes: The game launcher marks Art Studio, Music Maker, Fitness Fun and Patchy’s Mathy Treasure as ready to play. Word Wizard and Science Explorer are listed as coming soon, not playable releases.

contentItems.title: Apollo’s Adventure in Our Solar System
contentItems.notes: The supplied Amazon short link leads to Apollo’s Adventure in Our Solar System, credited to Apollo’s Learning Corner and Matthew M Davis. Friendly alien Apollo explores the planets from Mercury to Neptune in an illustrated children’s book.

contentItems.title: Refinery Creative — Bass Station II
contentItems.notes: Interactive Bass Station II patch manual and Web Audio synth for worship, ambient and post-rock. The page offers a 60-patch bank and distinguishes 48 synth patches from 12 hardware bass-through patches; browser emulation is not hardware audition proof.

contentItems.title: Ignite — Tinkerer’s Robot Lab
contentItems.notes: Five guided circuit builds cover LED light, blinking, button input, servo sweep and potentiometer control, plus a sandbox. Tap labeled pins and assemble instruction blocks; this is a guided learning model, not a substitute for real circuit safety checks.

contentItems.title: Ignite — Who’s That Robot Part?
contentItems.notes: A robot-component identification challenge: five mystery parts, eight seconds each and four answer choices. Its landing page invites quick rounds without sign-up. The cartridge sits beside the maker robot.

contentItems.title: Pluto LLC — Car Rental
contentItems.notes: Central Ohio peer-to-peer car rental business operating through Turo. The site describes Columbus-area pickup and local travel articles; use the link for current vehicles and booking details rather than assuming availability.

contentItems.title: DVGProOS — Business Toolkit
contentItems.notes: Connected business-toolkit portal presenting SaaSForge, Bookloom, LocalLaunch, RankPilot, CityLead and AgentCompany. The page invites early-access requests and includes solution concepts; listings are not evidence that every tool is available now. A storage box represents the toolkit.
